# DOT Hazmat Function Specific Training: Packaging

> 2-hour online function-specific training for hazmat employers and employees who identify, maintain, replace and use packages for hazardous materials transportation, under DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations 49 CFR Part 173. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 2 hours; 2 modules, 3 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.2 CEU
- Price: $39.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and in-person formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none (builds on 4-hour DOT Hazmat General Awareness)
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years (recurrent training at least every three years, and when relevant regulations change)

## Topics
- Package vs. packaging
- General and specific packaging requirements, using the Hazardous Materials Table
- Four types of hazmat excepted from the general packaging requirements, including limited and small quantities
- UN standard packaging elements and requirements (packing group letters: X = PG I, II, III; Y = PG II, III; Z = PG III)
- Salvage drums and overpacks; leaking and damaged containers; liquid hazmat; empty packaging
- Reuse and reconditioning of packaging

## Lessons
1. Regulatory Overview
2. General Packaging Requirements
3. Specific Packaging Requirements

## Who should take it
Hazmat employees handling materials for shipment; packaging supervisors and warehouse staff; carriers that package hazmat; shippers; transport and logistics personnel; safety managers and compliance officers.
